lesson: The short entry failed because it ignored a localized Wyckoff Spring at the 22.95 support level, leading to a liquidity sweep rather than a breakdown. The system correctly identified the macro downtrend but failed to account for short-term demand absorption at key structural lows.
adjustment: Require a confirmed break of market structure (BOS) on the 15m timeframe following a sweep of liquidity before entering shorts at established support levels.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC liquidity sweeps more than EMA trend alignment for entry timing on alts.
